title: Cloud Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build strong foundations in programming, Linux, networking and cloud platforms, then progress into infrastructure automation, containers, reliability and cloud architecture.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme beginning in 2026 and graduating around 2030. Shift the years if your actual programme duration differs.

blocks.text: 4-year honours variant

If you choose a four-year honours route, use the additional year for advanced cloud architecture, distributed systems, Kubernetes, cloud security, research or an extended industry project. The honours year is not automatically required for an entry-level Cloud Engineer role.

blocks.text: PhD routes

Senior cloud professionals can remain relevant by moving from individual infrastructure management into distributed-system architecture, platform engineering, cloud security, reliability, cost optimisation and technical leadership. Keep hands-on knowledge of automation and cloud-native technologies while developing the ability to design systems across multiple constraints.
